segment_summaries.content: Program statement: basis questions for systems of rational and whole rational functions, with field theory as the core method.
segment_summaries.choices: German ganze rationale Funktionen kept as whole/integral rational functions, not silently flattened to polynomials; terminology flagged for cumulative review.

segment_summaries.content: Known module basis result via Hilbert and full answer to rational representability/Rationalbasis questions.

segment_summaries.content: Definition of the basis problem via representation in a finite function set.
segment_summaries.choices: Displayed linear representation preserved; coefficient/function roles made explicit in Slavic prose.

segment_summaries.content: Contrast between rational representability and representability with a fixed denominator.
segment_summaries.choices: Fixed denominator kept as a technical constraint rather than stylistic paraphrase.

segment_summaries.content: Connection to Hilbert, König, and finite invariant systems.
segment_summaries.choices: Bibliographic titles left in source language where citation data; Noetherian body prose modernized.

segment_summaries.content: Separation between finiteness in the narrow sense and merely finite basis.

segment_summaries.content: Transfer principle from general systems to fields.
